title: The Funding Skew
description: A perpetual market maker's quote ladder. Avellaneda-Stoikov skews only for inventory; funding adds a second, signed skew that survives even at zero inventory. Drag the reservation line to set inventory, push funding and horizon, and watch the two skews stack or cancel.
controls: drag the reservation line (or arrow keys) to set inventory
sliders: funding rate, risk aversion, horizon
